title: Hollow Life
description: I mixed Hollow Knight and Grian's 3rd Life
body:
This is a spin on Grian's 3rd Life
# Hollow Life
At the start of the series, you will start with 3 lives.

With every life, you have 10 soul points. Every time you take damage, you lose 1 soul point. the only way to get soul points back, is to kill mobs.

## Recommended:
- Simple Voice Chat
- Carpet Mod (Helps if players leave.)

Please enjoy this datapack
